Name: Do You Do Poison
Author: DraconicArcher
Description:
The Ferngill Medical Research Facility is trying to make antidotes to common poisons. To do this, they need concentrated samples of as many poisons as they can get.

Distill poisons in the Poison Maker from everything from the infamous Red Mushroom, to poisonous flowers.

Thanks to Lumina, Button, Selph, and Esca on the SDV Discord for helping me with my code.

Thanks to mikezorz13 for recommending making a new machine to avoid mod conflicts.

The name of the mod is in reference to sketches from the British sketch comedy show [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EEyUeCyXl1Q]Bruiser[/url]
